name: South Africa
terms: Wine of Origin, region, district, ward, estate

South Africa's appellation system since 1973, nested from regions down to districts and wards. A ward is roughly a European appellation. An estate wine may come from neighboring farms farmed and made together.
A red blend with 30 to 70% Pinotage.

notes: The warm climate ripens grapes easily, and winemakers more often need to add acid than sugar.
Chenin Blanc is often made to drink young, with rich tropical notes such as banana, guava, pear and pineapple.
Pinotage ranges from easy-drinking wine and rosé to barrel-aged reds for cellaring, and newer styles are brighter and juicier.
Stellenbosch Cabernet is known as heavy and full bodied, while Constantia's is herbal and minty.
The best Semillon is juicy, with a citrus perfume, fine texture and herbal notes.

blurb.text: Chenin Blanc is the most planted grape, then Sauvignon Blanc, Colombard and Cabernet Sauvignon.
